name: @suluk/effect
description: Effect-native routes for the v4 contract: `sulukFn` — a composable unit carrying a SLICE of the core `Request`, so composing functions (controller→service→model, or any split) BUBBLES the whole contract up, bridging drizzle (state source) to hono (host + api reference). Typed HTTP errors bubble the handler's Effect error channel into detailed error responses; responses are DERIVED from the handler's A/E types. CANDIDATE tooling.
